thread:
Ria: Heads-up: Product wants route-level QoS tags (gold|silver|bronze) surfaced in Console and consumed by routing for burst policies. Need to decide telemetry shape and migration approach.

Matt: Agree. Two axes: where to store label for analytics (embedded in events vs join to route_metadata), and how to roll forward without huge backfill costs.

Cheng: Embedding is simplest for query speed. Cardinality is tiny. But altering console_events table is heavy and backfills are expensive for full history.

Olivia: Console dashboards rely on events_by_route scans with few joins. If qos is in the events row and indexed, filtering is cheap. Otherwise, joins kill page latency.

Samira: Routing/quotas must read qos synchronously from route-config (runtime store). So keep a single source of truth there. Telemetry can mirror it for analysis.

Ria: Product wants new routes to reflect QoS immediately; historical accuracy can lag up to 30 days. That opens an incremental plan.

Matt: Plan sketch A: add qos_label nullable to events, ingest populates for new events, treat NULL as 'bronze' in UI, backfill active tenants later, add index post-backfill.

Cheng: Variant B: dual-write at ingest (shadow write) + partial index for recent window now to keep UI snappy, followed by full backfill and global index.

Olivia: Partial index is attractive for minimizing index bloat while covering live traffic. We'll still need to recompute aggregates after backfill for dashboards.

Samira: Also flag alerts that use historical counts. We'll need a compatibility note so alerting owners know when values are estimated.

infra-bot: Backfill projection (top 250 tenants): ~3.2TB read, ~600GB write, ~5-6 hours with throttling. Recommend off-peak and patience. Runbook: https://ci/internal/backfill-runbook

Cheng: DB changes:

ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN qos_label VARCHAR(8);
-- add partial index covering recent partitions
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_qos_recent ON console_events(qos_label, route_id) WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '7 days';

Ria: API/contract notes: bump event-schema to 2 and advertise x-event-schema:2 header for strict consumers. Default consumers treat missing qos as 'bronze'. Document behavior.

Olivia: UI: show "QoS labels applied since <date>" banner and allow toggling to hide defaulted history. Also add small disclaimer on p95/p99 tiles when data includes defaulted rows.

Samira: Enterprise rollout: add feature-flag in route-config API, default-off for partner tenants until routing tests pass. Also run quota simulations with this label before enabling.

Matt: Monitoring: add a short-lived metric for fraction of events with NULL qos per tenant. Alert if > threshold post-rollout.

Cheng: Backfill run: phased by tenant activity score, start low-traffic tenants first, cap concurrency. After backfill, create global index on (qos_label, route_id) and drop partial.

Ria: Action items & owners:
- Cheng: migration PR + partial-index plan
- Ria + infra: ingest change to populate qos_label
- Olivia: Console adapter + UX banner
- Samira: rollout gating + docs for alerts/billing
- infra: backfill ops and maintenance window scheduling

Ria: I'll write a short RFC with schedule and link to PRs tomorrow. Tagging owners: @Cheng @Olivia @Samira @Matt @infra-bot

Matt: Thanks. I'll review DB PR and perf tests.

Olivia: I'll audit dashboards for precomputed aggregates that need recompute.

Samira: Reminder: update quota evaluation docs to note route-config is source of truth for runtime decisions.

Cheng: Will post PR link when ready. Closing thread.
